packages.name: Creative Strategy Guidance
packages.description: Provides the editable strategic guidance used by Runneth’s creative workflows: the Creative Strategy Engine, creative-analysis methodology, hook and headline standards, and customer-review mining guidance. It does not install skills; both default and custom skills can use these files from the agent brain.

packages.name: Creative Strategy Foundations
packages.description: Provides Runneth’s default workflows for analyzing creative performance, generating creative direction, and producing briefs. It installs the analyzing, creative-generation, and briefing skills plus their routing instruction, uses the shared Creative Strategy Guidance package, and can be uninstalled when a user wants to rely only on custom skills.

packages.name: Meta and Voice of Customer Onboarding
packages.description: Available only through an explicit package install. Stages Meta and Voice of Customer onboarding docs, ready-made guard blocks, and the voc-data-pull, voc-audit, meta-ad-performance-analysis, onboarding-walkthrough, and dashboard-design skills. Meta Validation automatically invokes dashboard-design whenever onboarding builds, rebuilds, or refreshes a dashboard-form weekly report; the customer never has to name the skill. Its package instruction checks the per-workspace completion roster and offers onboarding at most once per conversation for an unrostered workspace. Installation only delivers files: before connected-account reads, routine creation, account-context writes, /agent/INDEX.md edits, or /agent/user.md changes, it discloses those effects and waits for an explicit human yes. After approval, post-install resolves the workspace only from the conversation's Motion context, creates human-confirmed workspace-scoped VoC routines, merges the shared guards, persists Meta account context, records completion, and asks whether to begin the walkthrough. The Voice of Customer Audit and walkthrough remain separately human-gated. All generated data is scoped to /agent/brain/<workspace>/ so multi-workspace onboarding stays additive.

packages.name: Hook & Script Mining
packages.description: Turns one submitted ad, creator post, adjacent-brand ad, or organic asset plus the person's taste note into a human-confirmed swipe-file entry classified as a hook tactic, headline tactic, visual format, or creative mechanic, then promotes confirmed patterns into inputs for the ideation engine. Automatically installs and updates for ai-training-club-26. Its package instruction offers Apify connection and the first library build without touching account data until a human says yes; every seeded or submitted entry also requires confirmation. Once 3-4 confirmed entries exist, it offers a read-only swipe-file viewer and discloses that approval will create or update app source, write confirmed entries, download available media through Apify, and run the build. No app write, download, build, or sync routine is created before a separate human yes. Generated library data stays outside package-owned targets, uses only the workspace's own evidence and spend for swipe-file ranking, and never makes effectiveness or scale decisions.
